description: This PHP source file contains a test class named EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPITest, which extends EndpointTestCase. It includes multiple test methods that validate the functionality of the EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPI class, covering CRUD operations, validation rules, and integration with mock services related to employee immigration records in an HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that validates the EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPI functionalities in the HRM system, including retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and listing employee immigration records with mock dependencies.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeImmigrationRecordService
methods.description: Verifies that the API correctly returns an instance of EmployeeImmigrationRecordService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single employee immigration record by ID, including mocked DAO and service responses, and validation of the normalized output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the request validation rules for the getOne API endpoint, ensuring correct parameters and access control.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the deletion of an employee immigration record, including DAO method invocation and exception handling for record not found.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates the request validation rules for deleting records, ensuring proper parameters and authorization.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee immigration record, including handling of input parameters, mocking DAO save, and output validation.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks the validation rules for the update endpoint, ensuring all required fields and access controls are enforced.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies the creation of a new employee immigration record, including DAO interactions and output validation.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Ensures validation rules for creating records are correctly defined and applied.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all immigration records for an employee, using mocked DAO search methods and validating the list output and meta information.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the request validation rules for listing all immigration records for an employee.
